tools.name: get_agent_exposure_scanner
tools.description: Get the free FEDLIN Agent Exposure Scanner: a local, read-only tool that finds where AI agents on your machine can reach sensitive data (health and personal identifiers) and secrets. Returns install and run instructions. The scan runs entirely on your machine; nothing sensitive leaves it.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_agent_exposure_scanner" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_post_quantum · Private data: get_agent_exposure_scanner · Public sink: scan_post_quantum, scan_domain_trust · Destructive: get_agent_exposure_scanner.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_post_quantum · Private data: get_agent_exposure_scanner · Public sink: scan_post_quantum, scan_domain_trust · Destructive: get_agent_exposure_scanner

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
